title: LG 19A 10 Sweet Potato (PSB Sp 20): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: LG 19A 10 Sweet Potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: LG 19A 10 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. 100 to 120 days to harvest, 11.1 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: LG 19A 10 is a registered sweet potato variety, also sold or known as PSB Sp 20. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 1997 as NSIC 1997 Sp 20. It takes 100 to 120 days from planting to harvest, with 11.08 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 100 to 120 days from planting to harvest.
**Yield:** 11.08 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about LG 19A 10 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

LG 19A 10 sweet potato takes 100 to 120 days from planting to harvest. That is 4.5 days faster than the average of the 26 sweet potato varieties with a day count, 114.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 11.08 t/ha trails the average of its group, 15.15. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It was weak against scab, weevil, so scout for them from the early weeks.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its roots have light yellow flesh and red skin. Dry matter is 31.73 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 51.8 percent.
Where and when to plant LG 19A 10 sweet potato
Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: Is PSB Sp 20 the same as LG 19A 10?
items.a: Yes. PSB Sp 20 is another name for LG 19A 10, registered as NSIC 1997 Sp 20. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 100 to 120 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 11.08 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of LG 19A 10?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
